compiled_state.description:
## Testing Mode
GREEN

## Story DD Coverage
(None directly — this task implements the deterministic resolution helper + tag constant; the user-facing emission DDs dd-1/dd-2/dd-3 are owned by task-4 which consumes this helper's marker via SKILL.md wiring. dd-4 unit tests are owned by the RED helper-test task, whose suite this turns GREEN.)

## Implementation
Make the RED helper suite pass by implementing:
1. plugins/dso/skills/shared/constants/planning-tags.conf: add `TAG_FEATURE_FLAGS_APPROVED=rollout:feature-flags-approved` alongside the existing TAG_MANUAL_AWAITING_USER.
2. plugins/dso/scripts/implementation-plan/resolve-feature-flag-approval.sh: NEW deterministic helper. Runs `.claude/scripts/dso ticket show <story-id>` (READ-ONLY), parses the parent epic id, runs `ticket show <parent-id>`, greps BOTH outputs for the tag value sourced from planning-tags.conf (TAG_FEATURE_FLAGS_APPROVED). Emits a single-line JSON marker on stdout: {"feature-flags":"approved|prohibited","reason":"...","source":"story|parent|none"}. SAFE-DEFAULT PROHIBITED on no-parent or any lookup failure, always with a populated reason. chmod +x.
This helper lives OUTSIDE the LLM agent (task-decomposer is prohibited from ticket/shell access).

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Unit tests pass (exit 0)
  Verify: TEST_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.test_unit) && [ -n "$TEST_CMD" ] && $TEST_CMD
- [ ] Lint passes (exit 0)
  Verify: LINT_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.lint) && [ -n "$LINT_CMD" ] && $LINT_CMD
- [ ] Format check passes (exit 0)
  Verify: FORMAT_CHECK_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.format_check) && [ -n "$FORMAT_CHECK_CMD" ] && $FORMAT_CHECK_CMD
- [ ] Helper exists and is executable
  Verify: test -x plugins/dso/scripts/implementation-plan/resolve-feature-flag-approval.sh
- [ ] Constant added to planning-tags.conf
  Verify: grep -qF 'TAG_FEATURE_FLAGS_APPROVED=rollout:feature-flags-approved' plugins/dso/skills/shared/constants/planning-tags.conf
- [ ] Helper sources the tag value from planning-tags.conf
  Verify: grep -qE 'TAG_FEATURE_FLAGS_APPROVED|planning-tags.conf' plugins/dso/scripts/implementation-plan/resolve-feature-flag-approval.sh
- [ ] GREEN gate: the helper behavioral suite now passes (all five permutations + safe-default)
  Verify: bash tests/scripts/test-resolve-feature-flag-approval.sh 2>&1 | tail -1 | grep -qE 'FAILED: 0\b'
- [ ] Safe-default PROHIBITED carries a non-empty reason on lookup failure
  Verify: grep -qiE 'prohibited' plugins/dso/scripts/implementation-plan/resolve-feature-flag-approval.sh && grep -qiE 'reason' plugins/dso/scripts/implementation-plan/resolve-feature-flag-approval.sh

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus with full diagnostic context (all 3 failure messages)
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user with full failure history
If MAX_AGENTS: 0 at sonnet→opus escalation time: skip opus step, escalate to user immediately

comments.body: AC amendment (gap analysis, HIGH): once wired into SKILL.md Step 1, resolve-feature-flag-approval.sh runs on EVERY future implementation-plan invocation for EVERY story. It MUST degrade to safe-default 'prohibited' + exit 0 (NEVER non-zero, which would HALT Step 1 planning for all stories) on: (a) no parent_id / null parent (top-level/orphan story); (b) parent ticket show fails or returns sparse output (jira-* mirror sync lag); (c) ticket CLI unavailable; (d) neither story nor parent tagged. Each emits a non-empty distinct reason. Parse parent_id from the ticket show JSON 'parent_id' field. Verify: grep -qiE 'exit 0|return 0' plugins/dso/scripts/implementation-plan/resolve-feature-flag-approval.sh && grep -qiE 'parent_id' plugins/dso/scripts/implementation-plan/resolve-feature-flag-approval.sh
